build_collaborative_cooking_circuit: build the collaborative cooking circuit substrate environment using the base_config.build function
get_config_collaborative_cooking_circuit: get the default configuration for the collaborative cooking circuit substrate with ASCII map layout
create_config_layout: create a config layout with ASCII map defining the counter circuit environment layout
create_timestep_spec: create a timestep spec with RGB observation of 40x40 pixels and WORLD.RGB debug observation of 40x72 pixels
set_player_roles: set valid_roles to default and default_player_roles to two default players for the collaborative cooking circuit
